channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Pakistan sentences man to death for killing TikTok star Sana Yousaf
item.description: The verdict against Umar Hayat who killed a teenage influencer in her home 'is for the entire society', her father says.

item.title: Qatar says US-Iran negotiations need ‘more time’
item.description: Qatar’s foreign ministry says more time is needed for US-Iran negotiations.

item.title: At least one killed, 21 wounded in car bomb explosion in Syria’s Damascus
item.description: Blast occurs near Defence Ministry building in Bab Sharqi district of the capital.

item.title: Who was Amin Abdullah, the ‘hero’ guard killed in San Diego shooting?
item.description: Tributes have poured in for the guard, who was among the three people killed in the shooting at the San Diego mosque.

item.title: Trump says Iran attack on ‘hold’: What we know about latest negotiations
item.description: Tehran said its demands for peace include lifting sanctions against Iran but other sticking points likely to remain.

item.title: Iran squad in race against time for World Cup readiness amid US-Israel war
item.description: With Iran's local football league suspended since March, most players in the squad have not been in action for months.

item.title: Father-of-eight killed in San Diego mosque shooting hailed as hero
item.description: Security guard Amin Abdullah, one of three killed in the attack, was described as "a shining light".

item.title: Trump says he called off new Iran attack at request of Gulf states
item.description: The US president says he is holding off on an attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".

item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

item.title: Four killed in protests during Kenyan strikes over high fuel prices
item.description: Thousands of commuters are stranded, with key roads in the capital Nairobi largely empty due to the protests over fuel costs.
